# Demonstration dataset (showcase)

The showcase is a synthetic, reproducible dataset for demonstrating the W1/W2 web portal. It lives in its own
database (`passport_demo`) and file store (`backend/.storage-demo`), apart from the development and E2E database
(`passport`), so test runs never clutter the demo and the demo never affects tests.

**Everything is fictitious.** The organisations, part numbers, materials, documents and images are generated by
code in `backend/showcase/`. They don't use customer data, third-party CAD or real test results.
- Every PDF carries a "SAMPLE — NOT FOR MANUFACTURING" banner and watermark.
- Every part image is labelled "SYNTHETIC RENDER".
- The inspection report and material test certificate are blank templates with no results, signatures or
  certification statements.

## Set up, run and reset

All commands are run in `backend` and are development only (DEBUG). The embedded PostgreSQL must already be
running (`python scripts/localdb.py`).

```powershell
$env:DEMO_PASSWORD = "<choose a local password>"           # used for the demo accounts the seed creates
.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\demo_db.py create          # create passport_demo (if missing)
.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\run_demo.py setup          # migrate + seed_showcase (idempotent)
.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\run_demo.py worker         # CAD worker: converts the 31 queued STEP files
.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\run_demo.py api            # API on 127.0.0.1:8000 against the demo database
npm run dev --workspace web                                 # (repository root) web on 127.0.0.1:5173
```

- **Idempotent:** `seed_showcase` looks everything up before creating it. A second run creates and changes
  nothing (verified: identical row and audit-event counts).
- **Reset:** `scripts\demo_db.py reset` drops only `passport_demo` and deletes only `.storage-demo`; the script
  cannot touch any other database. Then run `setup` again.
- **Safety:** the seed refuses to run on a database whose name doesn't end in `_demo`, unless
  `--allow-any-database` is passed. Backend tests use that flag on the test database.
- **Back to development:** stop the demo API and start the normal `passport-api` (the E2E suite needs it).
- **Showcase records** are identified by organisation slugs `demo-maritime`, `demo-industrial` and
  `demo-energy`, part prefixes `DME-`, `DIM-` and `DES-`, and account domains `*.demo`.

## Contents

| Organisation | Projects | Parts | Passports | Documents (versions) | Sector |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Demo Maritime Engineering | 3 | 11 | 10 | 47 (48) | Ship equipment, marine spares |
| Demo Industrial Manufacturing | 3 | 11 | 10 | 49 (51) | Pumps, valves, gearboxes |
| Demo Energy Systems | 2 | 10 | 9 | 47 (48) | Power-generation auxiliaries |
| **Total** | **8** | **32** | **29** | **143 (147)** | |

**Passport data captured**

| Level | Passports |
|---|---|
| Incomplete | 5 |
| R-L1 complete | 9 |
| R-L1–R-L2 complete | 12 |
| R-L1–R-L3 with five sample evidence documents | 3 |

Three parts have no passport.

**Gates are unchanged.** Every passport is evidence level *Not assessed*, publication *Draft*, manufacturing *Not
eligible*, with only draft revisions. No approvals or QA verification are recorded (OQ-35/OQ-36).

**Files by part**

| Part group | Files |
|---|---|
| All parts with documents (31) | STEP model, converted GLB, synthetic image with metadata-free thumbnail |
| R-L1 and above | General-arrangement drawing (PDF, three orthographic views) |
| R-L2 and above | Multi-page manufacturing specification, inspection and test plan, work instruction |
| R-L3 sample parts (DME-1001, DIM-2001, DES-3001) | Machine details, print orientation, dimensional-inspection template, material-test-certificate template; also Rev B of the specification (version history), as does DIM-2002 |

**Geometry.** 11 parametric families: impeller, coupling, valve body, flange, bearing housing, sleeve, bracket,
gear housing, fan hub, pump cover, thrust collar. All 31 STEP files are different solids, with distinct volumes,
bounding boxes and SHA-256; a test enforces this.

**Not included: DWG.** No licensed or validated DWG writer is available, and renaming another format to `.dwg`
would be misleading, so the dataset has no DWG files (OQ-27).

## Demo accounts and access

Passwords are the `DEMO_PASSWORD` value used when the seed first created the account. They are never stored in
the repository.

| Account | Organisation(s) | Role | Sees |
|---|---|---|---|
| admin@operator.demo | Platform Operator | Operator administrator | Operator dashboard (operator tenant only), Clients page: each demo organisation with its members |
| engineer@operator.demo | Operator + all three demo organisations | Operator engineer | Picks the organisation at sign-in or with *Switch organisation*; full data and editing in each |
| admin@maritime.demo, admin@industrial.demo, admin@energy.demo | Own organisation | Client administrator | Own organisation's data, users, audit; no other tenant |
| user@maritime.demo, user@industrial.demo, user@energy.demo | Own organisation | Client user | Read-only; can preview but not download originals |

**Why the operator dashboard shows zero parts.** The dashboard summarises the *current* organisation, and RLS
limits every query to it. The Platform Operator organisation owns no parts, so its counts are zero by design.
Client data is visible only through a membership in that client (W1 rule, ACC-001), which is why the demo
engineer is assigned to each demo organisation. The operator administrator manages organisations and members
but is deliberately not given data access to the clients. Assigning them would use the same *Add member* flow.

## Suggested walkthrough

This is automated in `e2e/showcase/demo-walkthrough.spec.ts`; run it with
`npx playwright test -c e2e/showcase/playwright.config.ts` while the demo API is running.

1. Sign in as **admin@operator.demo** → *Clients* → *Demo Maritime Engineering* (members, assigned engineer).
2. Sign in as **engineer@operator.demo**, organisation *Demo Maritime Engineering* → dashboard → *Projects*.
3. *Digital inventory* → search `impeller` → **DME-1001** → passport **DP-2026-00001**.
4. Look at *Readiness data* (R-L1, R-L2, R-L3 tabs) and *Overview*.
5. *Interactive 3D model*: rotate, zoom, Front / Top / Isometric / Fit.
6. *Documents*: preview the 3-page specification and open *Versions* (v1 and Rev B).
7. *Switch organisation* → *Demo Energy Systems*.
8. Sign in as **admin@energy.demo**: one organisation only; searching `DME-1001` finds nothing.
9. Sign in as **user@maritime.demo**: read-only; another tenant's part URL shows *not found*; original download
   is refused (403) while preview is allowed.

Screenshots from that run: `e2e/results/screenshots/showcase-01…12-*.png`.
